title: Benchmark Factory: Agentic Benchmark Creation via Dataset Curation and Label-Free Quality Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2611.18890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Teams deploying coding agents need benchmarks built from their own code, but curating and validating them by hand is resource intensive, and an unvalidated benchmark can mislead silently. We present Benchmark Factory, an autonomous meta-agent loop with human checkpoints: an LLM agent writes sourcing queries over landed production code changes, runs models of known relative strength on each candidate, diagnoses why a candidate fails, and repairs it by editing its queries, prompts, and configuration until it clears quality anchors that need no per-task human labels. We used Benchmark Factory to build benchmarks for five developer cohorts at our organization. Engineering raters scored a 5% sample 2.3 for task quality and 2.6 for grader verdicts on a 1-to-3 scale. On configurations never used to build them, the benchmarks ranked Claude Opus~4.7 at high reasoning effort above low effort (60.6% vs. 54.4% of tasks passed, $p=0.002$) and GPT-5

translated_title: Benchmark Factory：通过数据集策划与无标签质量锚点的智能体式基准测试创建
translated_abstract: 部署编码智能体的团队需要基于自己的代码构建基准测试，但人工策划和验证这些基准测试非常耗费资源，而未经验证的基准测试可能会悄悄地产生误导。我们提出了Benchmark Factory，这是一个带有人类检查点的自主元智能体循环：LLM智能体针对已落地的生产代码变更编写数据采集查询，在每个候选任务上运行已知相对强度的模型，诊断候选任务失败的原因，并通过编辑其查询、提示词和配置来修复它，直到它通过无需每项任务人工标签的质量锚点。我们使用Benchmark Factory为组织内的五个开发者群体构建了基准测试。工程评审人员对5%的样本进行了评分，任务质量得分为2.3，评判器判定得分为2.6（1至3分制）。在从未用于构建这些基准测试的配置上，基准测试将高推理努力的Claude Opus 4.7排名高于低推理努力（60.6% vs 54.4%的任务通过率，p=0.002），以及GPT-5（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: Benchmark Factory提出了一种带有人类检查点的自主元智能体循环，能够从生产代码变更中自动策划、验证和修复编码智能体基准测试，其质量锚点无需每项任务的人工标签。
en_tdlr: Benchmark Factory presents an autonomous meta-agent loop with human checkpoints that automatically curates, validates, and repairs coding agent benchmarks from production code changes, using label-free quality anchors that require no per-task human labels.
